crossRefs.note: The cords of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.
He sent from on high. He took me. He drew me out of many waters.
Deep calls to deep at the noise of your waterfalls. All your waves and your billows have swept over me.
You still the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.
The floods have lifted up, Yahweh, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves.
now therefore, behold, the Lord brings upon them the mighty flood waters of the River: the king of Assyria and all his…
It will sweep onward into Judah. It will overflow and pass through. It will reach even to the neck. The stretching out…
Your rowers have brought you into great waters. The east wind has broken you in the heart of the seas.
After the sixty-two weeks the Anointed One will be cut off, and will have nothing. The people of the prince who come…
There will be signs in the sun, moon, and stars; and on the earth anxiety of nations, in perplexity for the roaring of…
He said to me, “The waters which you saw, where the prostitute sits, are peoples, multitudes, nations, and languages.
The ten horns which you saw, and the beast, these will hate the prostitute, will make her desolate, will strip her…

people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

translations.web: The sea has come up on Babylon. She is covered with the multitude of its waves.
translations.bsb: The sea has come up over Babylon; she is covered in turbulent waves.
translations.kjv: The sea is come up upon Babylon: she is covered with the multitude of the waves
translations.asv: The sea is come up upon Babylon; she is covered with the multitude of the waves thereof.
